tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Apacer AH155 32GB USB 3.2 Gen 1 Flash Drive is a reliable and affordable portable storage solution designed for everyday use. With 32GB of storage and high-speed USB 3.2 Gen 1 connectivity, this flash drive lets you store and transfer your important files, photos, videos, and documents quickly and efficiently.


Its compact and lightweight design makes it easy to carry anywhere — perfect for students, professionals, and home users. The AH155 is also backward compatible with USB 2.0, ensuring smooth compatibility with a wide range of devices including laptops, desktops, smart TVs, and other USB-enabled systems.


Get fast, dependable USB storage in Bangladesh with the Apacer AH155 32GB USB 3.2 Gen 1 Flash Drive, available at the best price from OTECH BD.


Key Features


  • Capacity: 32GB
  • Interface: USB 3.2 Gen 1
  • Backward Compatible: USB 2.0
  • Plug & Play: No drivers needed
  • Compact & Portable: Easy to carry
  • Wide Compatibility: Compatible with laptops, desktops, smart TVs, and more
  • Durable Design: Built for everyday use
